Do people actually believe this stuff?

Still learning how to navigate the personal grief of losing my friend, but also the societal hole his assassination has left behind.

Charlie was undoubtedly the leader of the conservative movement, but he also was a deeply needed moral leader for our gen

There are a million things wrong with this picture. But perhaps chief among them is the sheer mockery of the grit and strength it takes women to bring new life into the world from a depraved man.

Exactly a year ago tonight, I was packing up & heading to  labor and delivery to give birth to my beautiful daughter.

We have a health crisis in America
